programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep08

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep01
programme.desc: Ryusei Narukami, former Dark Lord and NEET, reunites with Meteor Hanaori, the former hero. Due to their carelessness, they are mistaken for a couple, and a chaotic school life begins!

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep02
programme.desc: Meteor and Ryusei attempt to uncover the true identities of the new transfer students, Mana Kuraishi and Minto Takigawa, but get caught. At night, a mysterious monster appears in the park!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep03
programme.desc: An Eater appears during Meteor and Ryusei's Dungeon Date! What's more, a monster called a Tomath also appears at the school. Behind it all is a mysterious girl who wants the Dark Lord...!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep04
programme.desc: School beauty Ayame Takanashi makes a move on Ryusei! Apparently, she used to be a totally different person..? Amid the escalating chaos, Sakura calls an emergency couples therapy session!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep05
programme.desc: Ryusei's troubles are never-ending as a school teacher. While Meteor struggles with her sense of purpose, Ryusei offers encouragement. After school, their patrol somehow turns into a date!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep06
programme.desc: Meteor transforms into a cat thanks to Minto! She enjoys her new form, even laying on Ryusei's lap. Later, Eriko Asahina, a magical girl from another world, appears and attacks Ryusei!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep07
programme.desc: Meteor falls into darkness after obtaining the 'Ring of Darkness'! Calling herself the 'Avenger', Meteor challenges Ryusei to a duel. He unleashes the Dark Lord's full power against her.

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep08
programme.desc: Meteor launches a 'lap pillow' attack on Ryusei!? A rare item appears on a channel with a shocking price!? Many are intrigued by Ryusei when he visits Oz, though some have ulterior motives.

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep09
programme.desc: A robot from another world bumps into Ryusei and falls in love with him. Meanwhile, Ayame is hassled by some bullies, and things take a sinister turn!? Later, the Mitsurugi Festival begins!

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep10
programme.desc: Ryusei Narukami is a NEET who was once a Demon King. He reunites with Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who defeated him long ago, now a high school girl. A romance between former enemies begins!?

programme.desc: This light-hearted 'a-go-go' romance depicts how three doctors pursue three beauties who play hard to get!

programme.title: Trilogy of Swordsmanship

programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: Vengeance of a Snow Girl
programme.desc: Enjoy Lo Wei's very last Shaw Brothers film, the fabulous tale featuring Li Ching of a frostbitten swordswoman out to get her parents' murderers.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: When Kuan, a guard at the Tien Ying Treasury House, falls for his boss's granddaughter, it isn't long before he begins plotting the elimination of his rival.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: A drifter (David Chiang) and another swordsman (Ti Lung) are competitors for a woman's love who fate turns into brothers in arms.

programme.title: Torrent of Desire
programme.desc: Flames of lust burn strongly in this high-octane melodrama that stars Jenny Hu, Yang Fan and Qiao Zhuang.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by 'Drunken Master', this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist who creates a cricket-style fighting technique to defeat the pugilists who bested him before.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: This star-studded martial arts epic adaptation of one of China's most celebrated novels is the sequel to The Water Margin.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: 5 Shaolin rebels train hard in order to successfully defeat their Manchu enemies. Starring David Chiang, Ti Lung, Alexander Fu.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: When villains 'Winged Tiger' Teng Fei and 'Underworld King' Yin Te Lung unite, the martial arts world is plunged into chaos. Can this deadly duo be stopped?

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu.

programme.title: Vengeance Is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: In this tale of greed, lust and vengeance, only Silver Swallow can stop the golden blade.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung

programme.title: The Younger Generation

programme.title: Rape of the Sword

programme.title: Swordsman at Large

programme.title: The Secret of the Dirk
programme.desc: Lovely Ching Li and handsome Chang I unite as star-and-sword-crossed comrades who take on the vicious Black Tigers gang in a quest for hidden wealth.
